posts.hook: For several hours on Friday night, no plane in America was allowed to take off
posts.caption: the faa halted every us departure for several hours, its third nationwide ground stop ever, and sources point to a network update, not an attack. reuters reports jensen huang misled nvidia's own general counsel, and a leaked document shows amazon planning to catalog nearly every product sold online. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: The FAA orders its ==third-ever== nationwide ground stop
slides.desc: Sources trace it to a network update that crashed air traffic control links. The FBI sees no attack.

terms.gloss: the us agency that runs air traffic control

slides.title: Amazon plans to catalog nearly every product sold online, even ones it does not sell
slides.desc: A leaked plan aims to make its index the one AI shopping agents rely on.

slides.title: Reuters: Jensen Huang misled Nvidia's own general counsel
slides.desc: The report says several leaders were misled about his relationship with Alice Huang.

slides.title: Sam Bankman-Fried's Anthropic stake would be worth ==about $37B==
slides.desc: The FT's math if Anthropic lists near $1.5 trillion. It was given up in 2024 for about $1.3B.

slides.title: Tesla opens Cybercab orders: about $30K plus a required $299 a month
slides.desc: The subscription is what lets the driverless car operate at all.

slides.title: Starship reaches orbit, setting up a possible upper stage catch on Saturday
slides.desc: Only its second flight to low Earth orbit. Recovering the upper stage is the missing half of reuse.
